title: City Parks to Host Annual Mile Marketplace October 3
summary: The Syracuse Department of Parks, Recreation & Youth Programs will host the annual Mile Marketplace on October 3, 2026, at Lower Onondaga Park. The expanded event features local vendors, artists, musicians, non-profits, fitness classes, and community activities designed to support local businesses while promoting park usage and community health.
